svg.title: A processor call that times out after the card was charged, retried two ways
svg.desc: Two timelines with lanes for our payment service and the processor. In both, we send charge $100 with key att_1 at 0 s, the processor charges the card at about 1 s, and its reply is lost. Our 3 second timeout fires with the outcome unknown. Top: we retry as a new request with key att_2 and the processor charges the card a second time, so the customer pays $200. Bottom: we retry with the same key att_1, the processor recognises it and returns the original result, so the customer is charged once.
svg.text: retry as a new request: two charges
retry with the same key: one charge
